pages.title: Plankton From SpongeBob SquarePants Plotting with an Evil Grin and Clasped Hands Coloring Page
pages.description: Plankton plots with clasped hands in this printable coloring page, showing a toothy grin beneath his lowered eyebrow and a pair of long antennae. The isolated figure has broad body sections, while the fingers, outlined pupil, and small antenna segments add compact details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plankton Holding the Krabby Patty Secret Formula Bottle Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Plankton holding the Krabby Patty secret formula bottle aloft, with a rolled paper inside and a cork in its neck. His wide smile and bent free arm fill the foreground, while sandy hills and a flower-shaped sky motif provide a simple setting for the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plankton Struggling to Carry a Krabby Patty Much Larger Than Himself Coloring Page
pages.description: Plankton struggles beneath an oversized Krabby Patty in this printable coloring page, lifting the layered burger above his head with sweat drops beside his face. Sesame seeds, ruffled lettuce, and angular cheese create separate sections across the towering sandwich, contrasting with his small body and the open seabed on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plankton Standing at the Entrance to the Chum Bucket Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Plankton standing at the Chum Bucket entrance, clasping his hands beneath a grin while the giant bucket-shaped restaurant rises behind him. The building has round door windows, a curved handle, and a large fist above its roof; a winding path adds broad open areas to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plankton Spying on the Krusty Krab Through His Chum Bucket Telescope Coloring Page
pages.description: Plankton spies on the Krusty Krab in this printable coloring page, looking through a large telescope beside a round window inside the Chum Bucket. The telescope's tripod and broad tube dominate the foreground, while riveted wall panels frame the distant restaurant, creating a mix of large shapes and smaller details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plankton Trying to Unlock Mr. Krabs's Secret Formula Safe Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Plankton trying to unlock Mr. Krabs's secret formula safe, gripping its large circular dial with both hands and grinning. The oversized safe door has a thick border, round bolts, and two prominent hinges, giving the coloring sheet broad panels around the smaller divisions of the lock.

pages.title: Plankton Examining a Krabby Patty Through a Magnifying Glass Coloring Page
pages.description: Plankton examines a Krabby Patty through a magnifying glass in this printable coloring page, standing beside a large burger with a grin and raised eyebrow. The sesame bun, wavy lettuce, cheese corner, and textured patty make distinct sections on the coloring sheet, while the plain background keeps attention on the inspection.

pages.title: Plankton Cooking a Failed Krabby Patty Experiment in the Chum Bucket Kitchen Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Plankton cooking a failed Krabby Patty experiment, holding a slotted spatula beside a steaming, lumpy patty in the Chum Bucket kitchen. He stands on a stool to reach the pan, with his other hand on his hip; the cabinet and stool add large geometric sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plankton and Mr. Krabs Facing Each Other Across a Table with the Secret Formula Bottle Coloring Page
pages.description: Plankton and Mr. Krabs face each other in this printable coloring page, with the secret formula bottle standing between them on a round table. Plankton balances on a stool while Mr. Krabs rests a claw beside the bottle, and the wooden tabletop and floorboards add linear details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plankton and SpongeBob Blowing Bubbles Together During Their F.u.n. Friendship Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Plankton and SpongeBob blowing bubbles together during their F.U.N. friendship, holding round wands and small bottles beneath floating bubbles. Their open smiles, SpongeBob's tie and striped socks, and Plankton's long antennae provide recognizable details, while the large circular bubbles leave spacious areas across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plankton Feeding His Pet Amoeba Spot From a Small Food Bowl Coloring Page
pages.description: Plankton feeds his pet amoeba Spot in this printable coloring page, setting down a small bowl piled with food beside the smiling, one-eyed creature. Spot's round body has circular markings, short rounded legs, and a curved antenna, making small enclosed shapes beside Plankton's larger silhouette on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plankton Surrounded By Spot and a Litter of Amoeba Puppies Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Plankton surrounded by Spot and a litter of amoeba puppies, raising both hands as the one-eyed creatures gather around him. Each amoeba has circular spots, rounded feet, and a curved antenna; their clustered outlines offer repeated small shapes around Plankton's broad central body on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plankton Arranging Souvenirs in His New Leaf Gift Shop Coloring Page
pages.description: Plankton arranges souvenirs in his New Leaf gift shop in this printable coloring page, holding a pointed shell beside a tiered display of seaside ornaments. Scallop shells, a starfish, a spiral shell, and a miniature lighthouse create varied enclosed shapes, while the counter and Plankton's body provide broader sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plankton Operating the Controls Inside a Robot Disguise of Mr. Krabs Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Plankton operating controls inside a robot disguise of Mr. Krabs, gripping two joysticks beneath the machine's tall eyestalks and claws. Rows of rivets, jointed arms, and broad mechanical feet surround the open cockpit, giving the coloring sheet a combination of large armor panels and small circular details.

pages.title: Plankton Wearing Mr. Krabs's Shirt and Trousers Behind the Krusty Krab Manager's Desk After Switching Lives Coloring Page
pages.description: Plankton wears Mr. Krabs's shirt and trousers after switching lives in this printable coloring page, standing behind the Krusty Krab manager's desk with hands on hips. His belt buckle, the papers on the desk, a tall chair, and a round porthole distinguish the office scene, with broad furniture panels across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plankton Learning a Self-defense Stance From Sandy Cheeks Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Plankton learning a self-defense stance from Sandy Cheeks, copying her bent knees and raised palms outside SpongeBob's pineapple-shaped home. Sandy's round helmet, flower decoration, large boots, and bushy tail contrast with Plankton's small figure, while the sandy background leaves open space around both characters on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plankton Wearing His Captain Pipsqueak Supervillain Costume Coloring Page
pages.description: Plankton wears his Captain Pipsqueak supervillain costume in this printable coloring page, posing with hands on hips, a pointed eye mask, and a flowing cape. Gloves, boots, and a belt with a round buckle divide the outfit into clear sections, while the plain background keeps the costumed figure central on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plankton Disguised as Gary the Snail Beside SpongeBob Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Plankton disguised as Gary the Snail beside SpongeBob, peeking from a large snail costume with a spiral shell and tall eyestalks. Plankton clasps his hands beneath a grin as SpongeBob looks down at him, and the shell spots and clothing details create smaller sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plankton Running Away From Pearl Outside the Krusty Krab Coloring Page
pages.description: Plankton runs away from Pearl outside the Krusty Krab in this printable coloring page, looking alarmed as she follows with clenched hands and an open mouth. Pearl's ponytail, pleated skirt, and sneakers add outfit details, while motion lines and the restaurant's curved roof establish the chase across the sandy coloring sheet scene.

pages.title: Plankton Wearing a King's Crown and Ruling SpongeBob's Aquarium Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Plankton wearing a king's crown in SpongeBob's aquarium, sitting on a shell-backed throne as three fish gather before him. The crown's rounded tips, curled armrests, patterned fish, and tall aquatic plant add distinct shapes, with gravel scattered across the bottom of the tank on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plankton Holding a Single Piece of Popcorn Coloring Page
pages.description: Plankton holds a single piece of popcorn in this printable coloring page, raising it beside his face while smiling with his other hand curled near his chest. The popcorn's bumpy outline and short inner curves contrast with his broad body, large eye, and long segmented antennae on the otherwise uncluttered coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plankton in a Striped Prison Uniform Behind Jail Bars Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Plankton in a striped prison uniform behind jail bars, gripping the two vertical bars with a frown beneath his lowered eyelid. Horizontal clothing bands and rectangular wall blocks create repeated sections, while the cell's bed and toilet add background shapes around the central figure on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plankton Hiding Inside a Fish Costume with His Antennae Peeking Out Coloring Page
pages.description: Plankton hides inside a fish costume in this printable coloring page, with his antennae poking through the top and his face visible through the open mouth. Large costume eyes, oval spots, curved scale marks, and fin ribs provide separate details, while his small hands and feet extend outside the disguise on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: SpongeBob Using His Hypnotism Gear on Plankton Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows SpongeBob using his hypnotism gear on Plankton, holding a round pendant above the small character as he stands on a stool. Curved motion marks surround the hanging disc, while SpongeBob's tie, striped socks, and the floorboards add finer sections beneath the large character outlines on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plankton Commanding Bikini Bottom Residents Wearing Chum Bucket Bucket Helmets Coloring Page
pages.description: Plankton commands Bikini Bottom residents in this printable coloring page, raising a fist from a rocky platform while three figures stand behind him wearing bucket helmets. The buckets' curved handles, the residents' shirts and trousers, and the platform's uneven edge provide distinct sections, with an open sandy setting around the group on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: SpongeBob Plankton at Jellyfish Meadow Coloring Page
pages.description: Plankton smiles in a jellyfish meadow in this printable coloring page, standing with his short arms lowered beneath a single large eye and two tall segmented antennae above him. Two floating jellyfish, small flowers, coral branches, grass, and rounded hills surround his simple oval body and little shorts.

pages.title: SpongeBob Plankton in Rock Bottom Coloring Page
pages.description: Plankton visits Rock Bottom in this printable coloring page, lifting both small hands with a toothy smile while standing on a broad rocky ledge beneath his long antennae. Strange sea creatures, jagged cliffs, branching coral, seaweed, and scattered stones create an unusual background around his single eye and oval body.

pages.title: SpongeBob Plankton on Sandy Ocean Floor Coloring Page
pages.description: Plankton stands on the sandy ocean floor in this printable coloring page, smiling beneath his single large eye and two long antennae with round tips and short crossbars. Seaweed, small coral, bubbles, and smooth pebbles surround his simple body, leaving wide areas between the bold character and background outlines.

pages.title: SpongeBob Plankton at Kelp Shake Coloring Page
pages.description: Plankton holds a Kelp Shake in this printable coloring page, smiling beside the large labeled cup topped with a rounded swirl and a bent drinking straw above it. His long segmented antennae reach above floating bubbles, with two seaweed clumps and small pebbles on the sandy ground below.
